en.name: Pimento cheese
en.summary: Pimento cheese is a spread of grated cheese, mayonnaise and chopped sweet red pimentos, sold ready-made in tubs. Keep it refrigerated and use it within about 4 weeks of opening. Homemade pimento cheese is far shorter-lived than the packaged kind.
en.pantry: This is a refrigerated spread and has no cupboard life, opened or not. It is a moist, low-acid mixture of dairy and egg-based mayonnaise, which is exactly what the danger zone between 4 and 60 °C (40–140 °F) was defined for. At a picnic or on a sandwich table, follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if it is above 32 °C (90 °F), and keep the tub on ice. A tub that has been warm for an afternoon should be thrown away rather than chilled and kept.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below on an inside shelf and use it within about 4 weeks of opening. Spread with a clean knife and never put one back in the tub after it has touched bread — crumbs and butter are what start mould in a cheese spread. Press the surface flat and keep the lid firmly on so it does not dry and crust. Homemade pimento cheese has no manufacturer's controls behind it and should be treated as a few days' food rather than a month's.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for pimento cheese, and freezing is a poor idea: the mayonnaise emulsion breaks on thawing and the spread turns oily and grainy, with the cheese going crumbly at the same time. It cannot be whisked back into a spreadable state. Buy the size you will use within the month instead, and if you have too much, cook it out — pimento cheese melts well into a toastie or a burger.
spoilage: Mould of any colour on the surface or inside the lid.
A sour, yeasty or fermented smell over the usual cheese-and-mayonnaise one.
Oil separating out that will not stir back in.
A fizzy or bitter taste, or a bulging tub.
tips: Clean knife every time; never double-dip from a sandwich.
Keep it on a shelf, not the fridge door.
Write the opening date on the lid.
Serve from a small bowl and keep the tub cold.

faq.q: How long does pimento cheese last once opened?
faq.a: About 4 weeks at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for the packaged kind. Homemade is much shorter — treat it as a few days.
There is no timeline for it and it is not worth doing. The mayonnaise splits and the spread thaws oily and grainy.

faq.q: Does pimento cheese need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Yes, always. It is a moist, low-acid dairy-and-mayonnaise spread and belongs at 4 °C or below.

faq.q: How can you tell if pimento cheese has gone bad?
faq.a: Any mould, a sour or yeasty smell, oil that will not stir back in, or a bulging tub.

zh.name: 紅椒起司抹醬
zh.summary: 紅椒起司抹醬是用刨絲乳酪、美乃滋和切碎的甜紅椒拌成的抹醬，市面上有做好的盒裝品。請冷藏保存，開封後約 4 週內用完。自製的保存期比市售短得多。
zh.pantry: 這是冷藏抹醬，不論開封與否都沒有櫥櫃保存這個選項。它是乳製品加蛋基美乃滋的潮濕低酸混合物，正是 4 到 60 °C 這段危險溫度帶要防的東西。野餐或自助三明治桌上請守 2 小時原則（超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時），盒子要放在冰上。在室溫放了一下午的那一盒請丟掉，不要冰回去繼續吃。
zh.fridge: 放在 4 °C 以下的內側層架，開封後約 4 週內用完。用乾淨的刀抹，碰過麵包的刀不要再伸回盒子——麵包屑和奶油正是抹醬長霉的起點。表面抹平、蓋子蓋緊，才不會乾裂結皮。自製的紅椒起司醬沒有工廠端的管控，請當成幾天內要吃完的食物，而不是一個月。
zh.freezer: 紅椒起司抹醬沒有冷凍期限，冷凍也不是好主意：美乃滋的乳化在解凍後會散掉，抹醬變得出油又粗糙，乳酪同時變得碎散，而且攪不回可以塗抹的狀態。請改買一個月內用得完的容量；真的太多，就加熱用掉——它融進熱三明治或漢堡裡很好吃。
spoilage: 表面或蓋內出現任何顏色的霉。
在原本的起司美乃滋味之外出現酸味、酵母味或發酵味。
出油分離而且攪不回去。
吃起來有氣泡感或苦味，或盒子鼓起。
tips: 每次都用乾淨的刀，抹過麵包的不要再挖。
放層架，不要放冰箱門邊。
上桌時舀到小碗裡，原盒保持冷藏。

faq.q: 紅椒起司抹醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 市售品放 4 °C 以下約 4 週。自製的短得多，請當成幾天內要吃完。

faq.q: 紅椒起司抹醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有對應期限，也不值得。美乃滋會分離，解凍後出油又粗糙。

faq.q: 紅椒起司抹醬需要冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 一定要。它是潮濕低酸的乳製品加美乃滋抹醬，必須放 4 °C 以下。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷紅椒起司抹醬壞掉了？
faq.a: 長霉、發酸或有酵母味、出油攪不回去、盒子鼓脹，任一項都要丟。
